content.summary: If you’ve been meaning to catch up on Lanterns or the latest season of The Gilded Age, Thanksgiving weekend is the perfect time to do so. And thanks to HBO Max’s new Black Friday deal, new and returning subscribers can now watch both shows for less. The streaming service is currently offering a 50 percent discount for Black Friday, bringing the price of its Basic With Ads plan down to $5.49 per month (about $6 off) for one year. The promotion runs through November 30th, and you can subscribe either via HBO Max or Amazon. HBO Max (one-year) Where to Buy: $10.49 $5.49 at Amazon (monthly, with ads) $10.99 $5.49 at HBO Max (monthly, with ads) HBO Max has plenty of great movies and shows to keep you entertained well into the new year, no matter which plan you choose.
